project.title: Global urban harbour and sewage bacterial communities
project.description: This study evaluates the global distribution of bacterial communities in urban harbours and sewage. The goal was to determine the universality of sewage sequences in impacted harbour waters and the utility of traditional and novel fecal indicators.
